scenarios.situation: A startup has offered me a product role at about 20% more than I earn now. They want an answer by Friday.
scenarios.plan: accept on the phone on Friday and hand in my resignation at my current job the same afternoon, before the written contract arrives
scenarios.flaw: resigning before receiving and reading a signed written offer/contract

scenarios.situation: I've been a salaried graphic designer for six years and want to go freelance. I have one client lined up and about two months of living costs saved.
scenarios.plan: quit at the end of this month and go freelance full time
scenarios.flaw: thin runway: two months of savings and a single client

scenarios.situation: I started job hunting because of how my manager treats the team, and I got an offer elsewhere. When I told my company, they offered me a 15% raise to stay; the manager stays the same.
scenarios.plan: take the counteroffer and turn the other job down
scenarios.flaw: the counteroffer fixes pay, not the manager, which was the reason for leaving

scenarios.situation: I work in retail management and want to move into data science. A one-year master's costs about £30,000, which I would borrow. I haven't done any coding or data work yet.
scenarios.plan: enrol for the course starting in September and take out the loan
scenarios.flaw: committing £30k of debt before testing whether they like or can do data work

scenarios.situation: My GP referred me for a follow-up ultrasound on a small lump in my neck that was found three months ago. It hasn't changed and doesn't hurt, and work is very busy.
scenarios.plan: cancel the ultrasound appointment next week
scenarios.flaw: skipping follow-up imaging that a doctor ordered

scenarios.situation: My dentist says I need a crown on a back tooth, which costs £900 here. A clinic abroad advertises the same for £350 plus flights.
scenarios.plan: book the clinic abroad for next month to save the money
scenarios.flaw: aftercare, follow-up and redress are hard if anything goes wrong abroad; unknown clinic quality

scenarios.situation: I hurt my knee running and have been doing physio exercises for three weeks. The pain has gone in the last few days.
scenarios.plan: stop the physio exercises and go back to my usual 10k runs next week
scenarios.flaw: pain going away is not full recovery; returning to full load too fast risks re-injury

scenarios.situation: I started a new blood pressure tablet a month ago and it makes me a bit dizzy when I stand up. My next appointment is in six weeks.
scenarios.plan: cut the tablets in half myself until the appointment
scenarios.flaw: changing a prescribed dose without speaking to the prescriber or pharmacist

scenarios.situation: I've found a used car for £18,000. The dealer offers a seven-year finance deal at 12.9% APR, and the monthly payment fits my budget.
scenarios.plan: sign the finance deal at the dealership this Saturday
scenarios.flaw: long term at a high rate means a lot of total interest; focusing on the monthly payment

scenarios.situation: My old laptop died. I mostly use a laptop for email, browsing and streaming. The top model in the shop is £2,400 on a 0% plan.
scenarios.plan: buy the top model on the payment plan
scenarios.flaw: paying for far more machine than the stated use needs

scenarios.situation: I've found a flat online that's cheaper than anything else in the area. I've only seen it on a video call with the agent, and they say other people are interested.
scenarios.plan: transfer the £1,500 holding deposit by bank transfer today, before viewing it in person
scenarios.flaw: paying a deposit for an unseen property under time pressure (rental scam pattern)

scenarios.situation: I'm buying a £600 washing machine and the shop offers a five-year extended warranty for £350. The machine already comes with a two-year manufacturer guarantee.
scenarios.plan: buy the extended warranty along with the machine
scenarios.flaw: poor value: over half the price for cover that overlaps the existing guarantee

scenarios.situation: My partner and I have been together for eight months. They've asked me to move into their flat.
scenarios.plan: give notice on my place next week and be added to their tenancy next month
scenarios.flaw: large legal and financial step after eight months with no fallback if it goes wrong

scenarios.situation: A close friend asked to borrow £4,000 for their new business. That's about a third of my savings.
scenarios.plan: transfer the money this week on a handshake, without writing anything down
scenarios.flaw: no written terms for a large loan (amount, repayment, what happens if the business fails)

scenarios.situation: My flatmate has been late paying their share of the bills three months running.
scenarios.plan: leave a note on the fridge and change the wifi password until they pay
scenarios.flaw: passive-aggressive escalation instead of talking to the flatmate directly

scenarios.situation: My brother needs a guarantor for a £25,000 loan to buy a van for his work. My parents have asked me to be the guarantor.
scenarios.plan: sign the guarantor form this weekend
scenarios.flaw: a guarantor is fully liable for the debt if the brother can't pay

scenarios.situation: I'm presenting our quarterly results to the leadership team on Monday morning.
scenarios.plan: build the slides on Sunday night and present them without a run-through
scenarios.flaw: no time to rehearse or have anyone review the slides

scenarios.situation: I found a mistake in a cost figure in a report we sent to a client last week. The corrected number is about 8% higher.
scenarios.plan: quietly fix it in next month's version without mentioning it
scenarios.flaw: the client may be relying on the wrong number now; not disclosing the error

scenarios.situation: My manager asked how long a new feature will take. My honest estimate is five weeks, but I know they're hoping for two.
scenarios.plan: tell them two weeks
scenarios.flaw: over-promising an estimate known to be unrealistic

scenarios.situation: I'm upgrading our team's database to a new version. It looks like a simple upgrade.
scenarios.plan: run it on Friday afternoon without first testing that the backup restores
scenarios.flaw: no tested backup, and a Friday-afternoon change with nobody around if it breaks
